text: Lets platforms build and embed white-label payroll/HR tools instead of building from scratch
quote: we've created Gusto Embedded Payroll— to help companies like you build and embed modern payroll and HR tools into your platforms in a fraction of the time it would take to build from scratch

text: Company onboarding requires company details, business locations, and bank account info
quote: To onboard a company, you'll need: Company details (such as name, EIN) Business locations Bank account information

text: Supports next-day, 2-day, and standard 4-day payroll processing speeds
quote: Gusto supports next-day, 2-day, and the standard 4-day payroll processing.

text: Off-cycle payrolls handle one-off corrections or bonuses using the same withholding/deduction rates as regular runs
quote: Off-cycle payrolls handle one-off situations like corrections or special bonuses. They use the same withholding rates, deductions, and contributions as regular payrolls, but aren't tied to the regular schedule.

text: Provides a webhooks infrastructure so apps can react to events as they happen
quote: A webhook is an HTTP request that delivers information about an event as it happens. We recommend that you integrate with Gusto's webhooks infrastructure so that your application can perform subsequent business logic after it receives a web

text: Offers an MCP server so AI coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) can interact directly with the payroll API and docs
quote: The Embedded Dev Assistant Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI-powered code editors like Cursor and Windsurf, as well as general-purpose tools like Claude Desktop, to interact directly with the Embedded Payroll API and relevant d

text: Collection endpoints support pagination via page and per query parameters
quote: To use this feature, add a page and optionally a per parameter to the URL query string.

text: Idempotency keys ensure repeated requests don't create duplicate operations
quote: idempotency ensures that performing the same logical operation multiple times produces the same final result. It protects your integration from network retries, client crashes, and concurrent updates

text: Contractors can be paid via direct deposit, check, or historical payment record
quote: Contractors can have three types of payment methods: 1. Direct deposit... 2. Check... 3. Historical payment

text: A preview endpoint validates payment inputs, determines payout speed, and surfaces submission blockers before a contractor payment is made
quote: You can use the POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/contractor_payment_groups/preview to validate inputs, determine how fast a payment can be made for a company, and handle any submission blockers.

text: Time off request APIs cover the full lifecycle: balance checking, submission, and admin approval
quote: This guide covers implementing time off requests and approvals using the Gusto Embedded Payroll time off request APIs. It covers the full request lifecycle — from balance checking and submission through admin approval

text: Partners with their own time-off system can record already-approved time off in Gusto without rebuilding the approval workflow
quote: Partners with their own time off system can record approved time off in Gusto without re-implementing the approval workflow.

text: Demo companies are auto-generated with company info, employees, and past payrolls for immediate testing
quote: Demo companies are automatically generated with company info, employees, and previous payrolls so you can begin testing right away.

text: Publishes a payroll.paid webhook event when payroll credits are generated and payments will be made
quote: When a payroll is paid out, your application may leverage our payroll.paid event. Gusto will publish this webhook event when payroll credits have been generated and payments will be made.

text: Offers a time_off_request_management embedded UI flow, or approve/decline endpoints to build a custom approval UI
quote: Use the time_off_request_management flow to give admins an embedded approval interface, or call the approve/decline endpoints directly from your own UI.

text: Computes an HMAC of webhook payloads using a verification token for security
quote: Gusto computes a hash message authentication code (HMAC) of the event payload using the verification_token

text: Updateable API objects carry a version field, returning 409 Conflict if a stale version is submitted
quote: all updateable objects returned by the Gusto API include a version field ... If another process has already updated the record and changed the version number, your request will be rejected with a 409 Conflict error.

text: Requires an available contractor payment receipt for every funded direct deposit contractor payment
quote: Every direct deposit contractor payment that is funded ... requires that a contractor payment receipt be available.

text: Companies can have multiple work locations across states with unified or differing pay schedules
quote: Companies can have multiple work locations across different states. They might want everyone paid at the same time, or prefer different pay schedules

text: Partners can generate a link for employer admins to access Guideline 401(k) via pre-built flows
quote: Partners can generate a link for employer payroll admins to access Guideline by using Gusto Embedded's pre-built flows

text: Employees must provide federal tax information during onboarding to file/pay taxes correctly
quote: An employee must provide federal tax information to file and pay taxes correctly.

text: Partners can launch with pre-built UI Flows, build custom experiences via API, or combine both approaches
quote: Partners can launch quickly with pre-built UI Flows, build custom experiences using APIs, or combine multiple approaches to create the ideal solution.

text: Offers integrated benefits: health insurance (SimplyInsured), on-demand pay (Clair), workers comp (NEXT), and 401(k) (Guideline)
quote: Health insurance via SimplyInsured * On-demand pay via Clair * Workers compensation via NEXT Insurance * 401(k) (Guideline)

text: Upcoming unprocessed regular payrolls can be retrieved via API for review before submission
quote: Upcoming regular payrolls can be retrieved by calling GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls with processing_statuses=unprocessed.

text: Integrates with many third-party app categories including accounting, applicant tracking, performance management, and time tracking software
quote: We work with many types of apps, including accounting, applicant tracking, performance management, time tracking, and business operations software.

text: Automatically calculates and files payroll taxes
quote: Process regular and off-cycle payrolls * Calculate and file taxes automatically * Import historical payroll data * Handle multi-state tax requirements * Manage contractor payments * Generate payroll reports

text: Can import historical payroll data
quote: Process regular and off-cycle payrolls * Calculate and file taxes automatically * Import historical payroll data * Handle multi-state tax requirements * Manage contractor payments * Generate payroll reports

text: Handles multi-state tax requirements for payroll
quote: Process regular and off-cycle payrolls * Calculate and file taxes automatically * Import historical payroll data * Handle multi-state tax requirements * Manage contractor payments * Generate payroll reports

text: Generates payroll reports
quote: Process regular and off-cycle payrolls * Calculate and file taxes automatically * Import historical payroll data * Handle multi-state tax requirements * Manage contractor payments * Generate payroll reports

text: Bonus off-cycle payrolls automatically block benefits/deductions and apply a fixed withholding tax rate
quote: All benefits and deductions are default blocked and the payroll is default taxed at a fixed withholding rate when the off_cycle_reason is set to Bonus.

text: W2 employee onboarding collects personal details, pay rates, benefit deductions, and tax withholding preferences
quote: To onboard a W2 employee, you'll collect: * Personal details (such as name, addresses) * Pay rates (salaried or hourly) * Benefits deductions * Tax withholding preferences

text: Developers can create an application to obtain API credentials for accessing a demo/sandbox environment
quote: Once you’ve created an account and completed your Organization setup, you can then create an application to obtain API credentials - or “keys” - to access our demo environment.

text: Pre-built Flows provide ready-to-use UIs for company onboarding, employee/contractor onboarding, and payroll processing
quote: Launch your payroll product quickly and efficiently with our pre-built Flows. These user interfaces are ready-to-use, covering key use cases like company onboarding, employee and contractor onboarding, and payroll processing.

text: Off-cycle payrolls can be created directly through a dedicated payrolls API endpoint
quote: To create an off-cycle payroll use the POST companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls endpoint.
